messages:
deploy-bot: Canary for release rc-9 quarantined in us-west-2: SBOM found transitive vuln CVE-2025-9999 in build tool 'pkg-builder' (medium). Action: quarantine canary.

alex: Noted. That's a build-time tool only, not included in runtime images, right?

jen: Correct — it's in the build container only. SBOM/provenance policy flagged it and deploy-bot quarantined automatically.

maria: Can we do a partial unquarantine? Only us-west-2 is blocked according to the alert.

sam: Deploy-bot quarantined any canary that referenced that build image. We can do a partial unquarantine by region if we verify runtime images don't carry pkg-builder.

alex: How do we confirm which clusters still have the build artifact?

sam: Quick check: ```aws s3 ls s3://redwood-builds/rc9/ --recursive | grep pkg-builder``` or `kubectl get pods -o yaml | grep pkg-builder` for runtime traces.

leo: I can evict build artifacts from registries but that means a rebuild for any job that needs them. Alternative: mark the package as non-runtime in SBOM tooling so it doesn't trigger quarantines.

jen: Security prefers an exception+audit rather than a silent bypass. If it's truly build-only, we can tag it "non-runtime" and do a formal exception with a ticket.

maria: Proposal: 1) Unquarantine eu-west-1 and us-east-1 canaries (they don't reference runtime images with pkg-builder). 2) Keep us-west-2 quarantined until hotpatch. 3) Open security exception ticket and schedule hotpatch in the next change window (tomorrow 03:00 UTC). 4) Update release notes + QA checklist.

alex: I'll run a runtime image diff and post results here.

sam: If you all agree, I'll create a deploy-bot override with reason: "build-only transitive vuln - partial unquarantine" and link ticket INC-4521.

jen: Security ACK pending the ticket and a hotpatch SLO. Will add required reviewers. :white_check_mark:

maria: @rachel from product — do you accept risk for non-prod canaries while we hotpatch?

rachel: We accept for canary traffic as long as the feature flag is off and product KPIs are monitored.

maria: Feature flag is off in these canaries. Proceeding.

alex: SBOM snippet for reference:
```
name: pkg-builder
version: 2.1.4
advisories: [CVE-2025-9999]
location: build-container only
```

sam: OK creating override + ticket and unquarantining eu-west-1 & us-east-1 now. Leaving us-west-2 blocked. Will paste links.

deploy-bot: Partial unquarantine executed: eu-west-1 -> UNQUARANTINED, us-east-1 -> UNQUARANTINED, us-west-2 -> QUARANTINED. Override ticket: INC-4521.

maria: Thanks. I'll add an action item: update SBOM policy to allow explicit "build-only" classification and add a checklist item to verify runtime image contents pre-release.

jen: Agreed — security will file a policy PR and follow up on INC-4521.

sam: Closing thread after I attach the ticket + logs. Will include rollback plan if hotpatch fails.

maria: Good. Documenting in release notes and tagging the release: rc-9 (partial canary resumed, us-west-2 blocked).
